items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: So only -- you know who was on the date. It was Jo Jones, Duke Ellington and myself.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. Bill Davis was going to

produce his own record, and he wanted -- he asked me to do it with him, yes. Here I was working at Birdland with someone then. So only -- you know who was on the date. It was Jo Jones, Duke Ellington and myself. Right? And "things aint' what they used to be." There were some good things.
